name: Bind
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within medium range. On a win, their speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of your next turn. On a loss, all effects still occur as on a win, but the creature may spend a half action to end them.

If the Condition you unchecked was Troubled, you may instead target a creature within long range.

Describe the bonds you create.
successes:
✨: The target cannot make attacks or cast spells that require physical movement.

✨: The target drops an object it's holding, chosen at random.

🌞: At the beginning of your next turn, repeat the roll against the same target. On a win, reapply the effect. On a loss, the effect ends. Repeat this on each of your turns until the spell ends.
